scope: Detailed selections refining existing architectural ADR, not independent ratified ADR

decisions.proposed_decision: Frozen nominal value objects for ProjectId EntityId RevisionId and Digest, not plain strings/NewType alone
decisions.required_falsification: A cast from ProjectId to RevisionId must fail at runtime
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: ASCII constrained canonical tokens with scoped project/kind; human aliases can be Unicode
decisions.required_falsification: Malicious path-like or empty identifier rejected
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: EntityRef always pins RevisionId; browser navigation by HEAD resolved outside normative domain
decisions.required_falsification: Reference without revision cannot be qualified
decisions.rejected_alternative: Floating latest revision in normative refs
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Store algorithm and exact byte digest; do not treat digest as logical entity identity
decisions.required_falsification: Equal bytes do not imply same owner or authority
decisions.rejected_alternative: Content hash as unique semantic ID
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Alias resolution is scoped and can return ambiguous; never first result wins
decisions.required_falsification: Two alias matches emit AMBIGUOUS_ALIAS
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: EMBEDDED/SIDECAR/FEDERATED storage modes with one normative owner per datum
decisions.required_falsification: Federated views retain independent Git revisions
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: ApprovedImport must scope source and contract; G00 accepts only external trust context
decisions.required_falsification: A file grant does not authorize whole repository
decisions.rejected_alternative: Import any link by textual similarity
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Separate immutable Git cuts, versioned documents and approved decisions; no branch-only authority
decisions.required_falsification: Pinned tree does not assert AST complete
decisions.rejected_alternative: Treat observed blob as verified function
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Known missing and exclusions visible in SourceUniverse; no global coverage by current records alone
decisions.required_falsification: Incomplete source inventory prevents complete claim
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Composed immutable references to versioned entities; no giant mutable Project object
decisions.required_falsification: Shared Property retains single ID across capabilities/campaigns
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: ObligationRevision owns requirement not execution status
decisions.required_falsification: Changing a status field cannot certify obligation
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Typed Atom/All/Any/Not plus trusted verifiers; no embedded project scripts
decisions.required_falsification: Project-supplied eval code rejected
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Belnap-style evidence pair YES/NO/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT with witnesses
decisions.required_falsification: UNKNOWN and CONFLICT not converted to NO
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Empty ALL/ANY rejected unless explicit approved TRUE/FALSE constant
decisions.required_falsification: An empty required predicate cannot auto-PASS
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Applicability separate from ratification and temporal exigibility
decisions.required_falsification: Future obligation remains visible but not automatically due
decisions.rejected_alternative: Use one status for all dimensions
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: G00 evaluator receives AuthorityContext from external trusted boundary; no self-signing
decisions.required_falsification: Textual role RATIFIED cannot grant authority
decisions.rejected_alternative: Trust JSON fields authored by agent
decisions.rationale: Preserve original G-00 obligation and guarantee no inference from mere presence of data

decisions.proposed_decision: Observed source fact and ratified norm are incomparable types; approved scoped supersession only

decisions.proposed_decision: ConflictRecord stores both witnesses, scope intersection, affected claims

decisions.proposed_decision: Trusted versioned RuleEvaluatorRegistry contains only pure registered functions

decisions.proposed_decision: Source/Decision/Commitment/Implementation/Audit/Material/Support/Qualification/Migration distinct

decisions.proposed_decision: Reader blocks unknown normative feature; informational extensions only in declared namespace
